fieldContext.note: Formal specifications use mathematical semantics (Z, VDM, SDL) allowing static validation to prove absence of deadlock or race conditions in high-integrity systems.
fieldContext.source: SWEBOK v4.0 Section 3.3 / Wing 'A Specifier's Introduction to Formal Methods'

personalNotes: Wing's pragmatic compromise: use formal Z underpinnings with human-readable visual surface syntax like UML statecharts to avoid heavy notation burdens on human reviewers.
